verdict.rationale: First-party docs name an agent-facing surface: Claude Code can push a design system into Claude Design via /design-sync or "work directly" with /design. That implies an agent can write to designs, but nothing documents what those commands can create or modify. No public write API or first-party MCP server is evidenced, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The PenPot MCP flow is PenPot's own MCP server with Claude Design acting as a client, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented write-capable API or MCP server, the scope and semantics of the /design and /design-sync commands, programmatic create/modify operations on design elements, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven edits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create or modify designs programmatically — through a write-capable API, plugin surface, or MCP tools — not just read them

citations.quote: Pull in your design system from Claude Code using /design-sync or work directly in Claude Code with /design.
Now you can use Claude Design from inside any conversation with Claude.
